Coat Studio

Coat colour theory, built from the ground up. Layer one is the base coat — the base fill under everything, mixed from red, green, blue and alpha sliders. Above it sit seven overlay patterns, each its own layer that can be set to any RGBA value: open a pattern and drag its four sliders to restyle it. And at the bottom, the Super Rare collection — seven one-of-a-kind gradient coats.

Eye Studio

Every option is the exact same eye — her original plush design: black outer ring, thin cream inner ring, one round highlight, two separate lash flicks. The only thing that changes is the inside circle: deep, dark colours around a near-black centre, shaded so it dips inward like a real concave iris — solid black in the original, a gradient when customised, never more than three colours. Six sliders below fine-tune the rendering itself.
